verses.display_text:
And He fed them with the finest wheat,
and with honey from rock He satisfied them.

cross_references.rationale: Both passages combine honey supplied from rock with wheat provision. The psalm calls it finest wheat; Deuteronomy names the fat of the kernels of wheat. These particular foods and differing descriptions are preserved.

target_verses.text: He brought them up upon the strength of the earth, and fed them the produce of the fields; they sucked honey out of the rock, and oil out of the solid rock,
butter of cattle and milk of sheep, with the fat of lambs and rams, young bulls and goats, with the fat of the kernels of wheat; and they drank wine, the blood of the grape.

verses.text: A psalm for Asaph. God stood in an assembly of gods, and in their midst He judges gods:
verses.display_text:

and in their midst He judges gods:

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

verses.text: But you die like human beings, and fall like one of the rulers.”

I was prepared and was not troubled
to keep Thy commandments.

verses.text: Sinners’ cords entangled me, and I did not forget Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Sinners’ cords entangled me,
and I did not forget Thy law.

verses.text: At midnight I would rise to give thanks unto Thee for Thy righteous judgments.
verses.display_text:
At midnight I would rise to give thanks unto Thee
for Thy righteous judgments.

verses.text: I am a companion of all who fear Thee and of those who keep Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
I am a companion of all who fear Thee
and of those who keep Thy commandments.

verses.text: The earth is full of Thy mercy, Lord; teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
The earth is full of Thy mercy, Lord;
teach me Thine ordinances.

verses.text: Nine: Tēth. Thou didst deal kindly with Thy servant, Lord, according to Thy word.
verses.display_text:
Nine: Tēth.
Thou didst deal kindly with Thy servant,
Lord, according to Thy word.

verses.text: Teach me kindness, discipline and knowledge, for I trusted Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
Teach me kindness, discipline and knowledge,
for I trusted Thy commandments.

verses.text: Before I was humbled, I did wrong; therefore I kept Thy saying.
verses.display_text:
Before I was humbled, I did wrong;
therefore I kept Thy saying.

verses.text: Thou art good, Lord, and in Thy goodness teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
Thou art good, Lord, and in Thy goodness
teach me Thine ordinances.

verses.text: The injustice of the arrogant multiplied against me, but I will search out Thy commandments with my whole heart.
verses.display_text:
The injustice of the arrogant multiplied against me,
but I will search out Thy commandments with my whole heart.

verses.text: Their heart curdled like milk, but I meditated on Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Their heart curdled like milk,
but I meditated on Thy law.

verses.text: It is good for me that Thou didst humble me, so that I might learn Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
It is good for me that Thou didst humble me,
so that I might learn Thine ordinances.

verses.text: The law of Thy mouth is better for me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.display_text:
The law of Thy mouth is better for me
than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.text: Ten: Iōth. Thy hands made me and formed me; give me understanding, and I will learn Thy commandments.
Those who fear Thee will see me and rejoice, for I placed my hope in Thy words.
verses.display_text:
Those who fear Thee will see me and rejoice,
for I placed my hope in Thy words.

verses.text: I knew, Lord, that Thy judgments are righteousness, and that in truth Thou didst humble me.
verses.display_text:
I knew, Lord, that Thy judgments are righteousness,
and that in truth Thou didst humble me.

verses.text: Let Thy mercy now be for my comfort, according to Thy saying to Thy servant.
verses.display_text:
Let Thy mercy now be for my comfort,
according to Thy saying to Thy servant.

verses.text: Let Thy compassions come to me, and I will live, for Thy law is my meditation.
verses.display_text:
Let Thy compassions come to me, and I will live,
for Thy law is my meditation.

verses.text: Let the arrogant be ashamed, for they unjustly acted lawlessly against me; but I will ponder Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
Let the arrogant be ashamed, for they unjustly acted lawlessly against me;
but I will ponder Thy commandments.

verses.text: Let those who fear Thee turn to me, and those who know Thy testimonies.
verses.display_text:
Let those who fear Thee turn to me,
and those who know Thy testimonies.

verses.text: Let my heart be blameless in Thine ordinances, so that I may not be ashamed.
verses.display_text:
Let my heart be blameless in Thine ordinances,
so that I may not be ashamed.

verses.text: Eleven: Chaph. My soul fails with longing for Thy salvation, and I placed my hope in Thy word.
verses.display_text:
Eleven: Chaph.
My soul fails with longing for Thy salvation,
and I placed my hope in Thy word.

verses.text: My eyes failed with longing for Thy saying, saying, “When wilt Thou comfort me?”
verses.display_text:
My eyes failed with longing for Thy saying,
saying, “When wilt Thou comfort me?”

verses.text: For I became like a wineskin in frost; I did not forget Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
For I became like a wineskin in frost;
I did not forget Thine ordinances.

verses.text: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou give me judgment against those who pursue me?
verses.display_text:
How many are the days of Thy servant?
When wilt Thou give me judgment against those who pursue me?

verses.text: Lawbreakers told me idle tales, but not in keeping with Thy law, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Lawbreakers told me idle tales,
but not in keeping with Thy law, Lord.

verses.text: All Thy commandments are truth; they pursued me unjustly—help me.
verses.display_text:
All Thy commandments are truth;
they pursued me unjustly—help me.

verses.text: They nearly brought me to an end on the earth, but I did not forsake Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
They nearly brought me to an end on the earth,
but I did not forsake Thy commandments.

verses.text: Give me life according to Thy mercy, and I will keep the testimonies of Thy mouth.
verses.display_text:
Give me life according to Thy mercy,
and I will keep the testimonies of Thy mouth.

verses.text: Twelve: Labd. For ever, Lord, Thy word remains in heaven.
verses.display_text:
Twelve: Labd.
For ever, Lord,
Thy word remains in heaven.

verses.text: Thy truth is from generation to generation; Thou didst found the earth, and it remains.
verses.display_text:
Thy truth is from generation to generation;
Thou didst found the earth, and it remains.

verses.text: By Thine arrangement the day remains, for all things are Thy servants.
verses.display_text:
By Thine arrangement the day remains,
for all things are Thy servants.

verses.text: If Thy law had not been my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
verses.display_text:
If Thy law had not been my meditation,
then I would have perished in my humiliation.

verses.text: I will certainly never forget Thine ordinances, for by them Thou gavest me life, Lord.
verses.display_text:
I will certainly never forget Thine ordinances,
for by them Thou gavest me life, Lord.

verses.text: I am Thine; save me, for I sought Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
I am Thine; save me,
for I sought Thine ordinances.

verses.text: Sinners waited for me to destroy me; I understood Thy testimonies.
verses.display_text:
Sinners waited for me to destroy me;
I understood Thy testimonies.

verses.text: I saw an end to every completion; Thy commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.display_text:
I saw an end to every completion;
Thy commandment is exceedingly broad.

verses.text: Thirteen: Mēm. How I loved Thy law, Lord! It is my meditation all day.
verses.display_text:
Thirteen: Mēm.
How I loved Thy law, Lord!
It is my meditation all day.

verses.text: Thou madest me wiser than my enemies in Thy commandment, for it is mine for ever.
verses.display_text:
Thou madest me wiser than my enemies in Thy commandment,
for it is mine for ever.

verses.text: I understood more than all who teach me, for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.display_text:
I understood more than all who teach me,
for Thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.text: I understood more than elders, for I sought Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
I understood more than elders,
for I sought Thy commandments.

verses.text: I restrained my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Thy words.
verses.display_text:
I restrained my feet from every evil way,
so that I might keep Thy words.

verses.text: I did not turn away from Thy judgments, for Thou didst instruct me.
verses.display_text:
I did not turn away from Thy judgments,
for Thou didst instruct me.

verses.text: How sweet are Thy sayings to my throat, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth!
verses.display_text:
How sweet are Thy sayings to my throat,
beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth!

verses.text: From Thy commandments I gained understanding; therefore I hated every way of injustice, for Thou didst instruct me.
Fourteen: Noun. Thy word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my paths.
verses.display_text:
Fourteen: Noun.
Thy word is a lamp to my feet
and a light to my paths.

verses.text: I have sworn and established it: to keep Thy righteous judgments.
verses.display_text:
I have sworn and established it:
to keep Thy righteous judgments.

verses.text: I was humbled to an extreme; Lord, give me life according to Thy word.
verses.display_text:
I was humbled to an extreme;
Lord, give me life according to Thy word.

verses.text: Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, Lord, and teach me Thy judgments.
verses.display_text:
Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, Lord,
and teach me Thy judgments.

verses.text: My soul is in my hands continually, and I did not forget Thy law.
verses.display_text:
My soul is in my hands continually,
and I did not forget Thy law.

verses.text: Sinners set a trap for me, and I did not wander from Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
Sinners set a trap for me,
and I did not wander from Thy commandments.

verses.text: I inherited Thy testimonies for ever, for they are my heart’s rejoicing.
verses.display_text:
I inherited Thy testimonies for ever,
for they are my heart’s rejoicing.

verses.text: I bent my heart to perform Thine ordinances for ever, for a recompense.
verses.display_text:
I bent my heart to perform Thine ordinances
for ever, for a recompense.

verses.text: Fifteen: Samch. I hated lawbreakers, and I loved Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Fifteen: Samch.
I hated lawbreakers,
and I loved Thy law.

verses.text: Thou art my helper and my upholder; I placed my hope in Thy word.
verses.display_text:
Thou art my helper and my upholder;
I placed my hope in Thy word.

verses.text: Turn away from me, evildoers, and I will search out my God’s commandments.
verses.display_text:
Turn away from me, evildoers,
and I will search out my God’s commandments.

verses.text: Uphold me according to Thy saying, and I will live; and do not put me to shame in my expectation.
verses.display_text:
Uphold me according to Thy saying, and I will live;
and do not put me to shame in my expectation.

verses.text: Help me, and I will be saved; and I will meditate on Thine ordinances continually.
verses.display_text:
Help me, and I will be saved;
and I will meditate on Thine ordinances continually.

verses.text: Thou didst despise all who depart from Thine ordinances, for their thought is unjust.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst despise all who depart from Thine ordinances,
for their thought is unjust.

verses.text: I reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore I loved Thy testimonies continually.
verses.display_text:
I reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors;
therefore I loved Thy testimonies continually.

verses.text: Nail down my flesh through fear of Thee, for I feared Thy judgments.
verses.display_text:
Nail down my flesh through fear of Thee,
for I feared Thy judgments.

verses.text: Sixteen: Ain. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those who wrong me.
Receive Thy servant for good; do not let the arrogant oppress me with false accusations.
verses.display_text:
Receive Thy servant for good;
do not let the arrogant oppress me with false accusations.

verses.text: My eyes failed with longing for Thy salvation and for Thy righteous saying.
verses.display_text:
My eyes failed with longing for Thy salvation
and for Thy righteous saying.

verses.text: Deal with Thy servant according to Thy mercy, and teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
Deal with Thy servant according to Thy mercy,
and teach me Thine ordinances.

verses.text: I am Thy servant; give me understanding, and I will know Thy testimonies.
verses.display_text:
I am Thy servant; give me understanding,
and I will know Thy testimonies.

verses.text: It is time to act for the Lord; they scattered Thy law.
verses.display_text:
It is time to act for the Lord;
they scattered Thy law.

verses.text: Therefore I loved Thy commandments more than gold and topaz.
verses.display_text:
Therefore I loved Thy commandments
more than gold and topaz.

verses.text: Therefore I was set right toward all Thy commandments; I hated every unjust way.
verses.display_text:
Therefore I was set right toward all Thy commandments;
I hated every unjust way.

verses.text: Seventeen: Phē. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul searched them out.
The disclosure of Thy words will give light and understanding to the simple.
verses.display_text:
The disclosure of Thy words will give light
and understanding to the simple.

verses.text: I opened my mouth and drew breath, for I longed for Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
I opened my mouth and drew breath,
for I longed for Thy commandments.

verses.text: Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment for those who love Thy name.
verses.display_text:
Look upon me and have mercy on me,
according to the judgment for those who love Thy name.

verses.text: Direct my steps according to Thy saying, and let no lawlessness rule over me.
verses.display_text:
Direct my steps according to Thy saying,
and let no lawlessness rule over me.

verses.text: Redeem me from people’s oppression through false accusation, and I will keep Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
Redeem me from people’s oppression through false accusation,
and I will keep Thy commandments.

verses.text: Shine Thy face upon Thy servant, and teach me Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
Shine Thy face upon Thy servant,
and teach me Thine ordinances.

verses.text: Streams of water ran down from my eyes, since they did not keep Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Streams of water ran down from my eyes,
since they did not keep Thy law.

verses.text: Eighteen: Sadē. Thou art righteous, Lord, and Thy judgment is upright.
verses.display_text:
Eighteen: Sadē.
Thou art righteous, Lord,
and Thy judgment is upright.

verses.text: Thou didst command Thy testimonies as righteousness and exceeding truth.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst command Thy testimonies as righteousness
and exceeding truth.

verses.text: Zeal for Thy house melted me away, for my enemies forgot Thy words.
verses.display_text:
Zeal for Thy house melted me away,
for my enemies forgot Thy words.

verses.text: Thy saying has been thoroughly refined by fire, and Thy servant loved it.
verses.display_text:
Thy saying has been thoroughly refined by fire,
and Thy servant loved it.

verses.text: I am younger and despised; I did not forget Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
I am younger and despised;
I did not forget Thine ordinances.

verses.text: Thy righteousness is righteousness for ever, and Thy law is truth.
verses.display_text:
Thy righteousness is righteousness for ever,
and Thy law is truth.

verses.text: Affliction and constraint found me; Thy commandments are my meditation.
verses.display_text:
Affliction and constraint found me;
Thy commandments are my meditation.

verses.text: Thy testimonies are righteousness for ever; give me understanding, and I will live.
verses.display_text:
Thy testimonies are righteousness for ever;
give me understanding, and I will live.

verses.text: Nineteen: Kōph. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, Lord; I will seek Thine ordinances.
I cried unto Thee; save me, and I will keep Thy testimonies.
verses.display_text:
I cried unto Thee; save me,
and I will keep Thy testimonies.

verses.text: I rose early at an untimely hour and cried out; I placed my hope in Thy words.
verses.display_text:
I rose early at an untimely hour and cried out;
I placed my hope in Thy words.

verses.text: My eyes were awake before dawn to meditate on Thy sayings.
verses.display_text:
My eyes were awake before dawn
to meditate on Thy sayings.

verses.text: Hear my voice, Lord, according to Thy mercy; give me life according to Thy judgment.
verses.display_text:
Hear my voice, Lord, according to Thy mercy;
give me life according to Thy judgment.

verses.text: Those who pursue me with lawlessness drew near, but they were far from Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Those who pursue me with lawlessness drew near,
but they were far from Thy law.

verses.text: Thou art near, Lord, and all Thy commandments are truth.
verses.display_text:
Thou art near, Lord,
and all Thy commandments are truth.

verses.text: From the beginning I knew from Thy testimonies that Thou didst establish them for ever.
verses.display_text:
From the beginning I knew from Thy testimonies
that Thou didst establish them for ever.

verses.text: Twenty: Rēs. See my humiliation and rescue me, for I did not forget Thy law.
verses.display_text:
Twenty: Rēs.
See my humiliation and rescue me,
for I did not forget Thy law.

verses.text: Judge my case and redeem me; give me life because of Thy word.
verses.display_text:
Judge my case and redeem me;
give me life because of Thy word.

verses.text: Salvation is far from sinners, for they did not seek Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
Salvation is far from sinners,
for they did not seek Thine ordinances.

verses.text: Thy compassions are many, Lord; give me life according to Thy judgment.
verses.display_text:
Thy compassions are many, Lord;
give me life according to Thy judgment.

verses.text: Many are those who pursue me and press me hard; I did not turn away from Thy testimonies.
verses.display_text:
Many are those who pursue me and press me hard;
I did not turn away from Thy testimonies.

verses.text: I saw those who break faith and melted away, for they did not keep Thy sayings.
verses.display_text:
I saw those who break faith and melted away,
for they did not keep Thy sayings.

verses.text: See that I loved Thy commandments; Lord, give me life in Thy mercy.
verses.display_text:
See that I loved Thy commandments;
Lord, give me life in Thy mercy.

verses.text: The beginning of Thy words is truth, and all Thy righteous judgments endure for ever.
verses.display_text:
The beginning of Thy words is truth,
and all Thy righteous judgments endure for ever.

verses.text: Twenty-one: Sen. Rulers pursued me without cause, and my heart was afraid of Thy words.
verses.display_text:
Twenty-one: Sen.
Rulers pursued me without cause,
and my heart was afraid of Thy words.

verses.text: I will rejoice in Thy sayings like one who finds much spoil.
verses.display_text:
I will rejoice in Thy sayings
like one who finds much spoil.

verses.text: I hated and abhorred injustice, but I loved Thy law.
verses.display_text:
I hated and abhorred injustice,
but I loved Thy law.

verses.text: Seven times a day I praised Thee for Thy righteous judgments.
verses.display_text:
Seven times a day I praised Thee
for Thy righteous judgments.

verses.text: Great peace belongs to those who love Thy law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
verses.display_text:
Great peace belongs to those who love Thy law,
and there is no stumbling block for them.

verses.text: I awaited Thy salvation, Lord, and I loved Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
I awaited Thy salvation, Lord,
and I loved Thy commandments.

verses.text: My soul kept Thy testimonies and loved them greatly.
verses.display_text:
My soul kept Thy testimonies
and loved them greatly.

verses.text: I kept Thy commandments and Thy testimonies, for all my ways are before Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text:
I kept Thy commandments and Thy testimonies,
for all my ways are before Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Twenty-two: Thau. Let my supplication draw near before Thee, Lord; give me understanding according to Thy saying.
May my plea enter before Thee; deliver me according to Thy saying.
verses.display_text:
May my plea enter before Thee;
deliver me according to Thy saying.

verses.text: May my lips pour forth a hymn when Thou teachest me Thine ordinances.
verses.display_text:
May my lips pour forth a hymn

verses.text: May my tongue utter Thy saying, for all Thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.display_text:
May my tongue utter Thy saying,
for all Thy commandments are righteousness.

verses.text: Let Thy hand be for saving me, for I chose Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
Let Thy hand be for saving me,
for I chose Thy commandments.

verses.text: I longed for Thy salvation, Lord, and Thy law is my meditation.
verses.display_text:
I longed for Thy salvation, Lord,
and Thy law is my meditation.

verses.text: My soul will live and praise Thee, and Thy judgments will help me.
verses.display_text:
My soul will live and praise Thee,
and Thy judgments will help me.

verses.text: I wandered like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant, for I did not forget Thy commandments.
verses.display_text:
I wandered like a lost sheep;
seek Thy servant, for I did not forget Thy commandments.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. To the Lord, when I was afflicted, I cried, and He heard me.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
To the Lord, when I was afflicted,
I cried, and He heard me.

verses.display_text:
Lord, rescue my soul from unjust lips
and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.display_text:
What might be given to you, and what might be added to you,

verses.display_text:
The mighty one’s sharpened arrows,
with desert coals.

verses.text: Alas for me, for my sojourn has been prolonged; I have encamped among the tents of Kedar.
verses.display_text:
Alas for me, for my sojourn has been prolonged;

verses.text: My soul has sojourned a long time.
verses.display_text: My soul has sojourned a long time.

verses.display_text:
With those who hate peace I was peaceable;
whenever I spoke to them, they fought me without cause.

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

then they would have swallowed us alive

verses.text: For darkness will not be dark from Thee, and night will be lit up like day; as its darkness, so also its light.
For Thou didst acquire my kidneys, Lord; Thou didst support me from my mother’s womb.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst acquire my kidneys, Lord;
Thou didst support me from my mother’s womb.

verses.text: I will thank Thee, for I was made fearfully wonderful; wondrous are Thy works, and my soul knows very well.
My bone was not hidden from Thee, which Thou madest in secret, and my substance in earth’s lowest places.
verses.display_text:
My bone was not hidden from Thee, which Thou madest in secret,
and my substance in earth’s lowest places.

verses.text: Thine eyes saw my unworked substance, and in Thy book all will be written; they will be formed over days, and none among them.
Thy friends were greatly honored by me, God; their beginnings grew very strong.
verses.display_text:
Thy friends were greatly honored by me, God;
their beginnings grew very strong.

verses.text: I will count them, and they will multiply beyond the sand; I awoke, and I am still with Thee.
verses.display_text:
I will count them, and they will multiply beyond the sand;
I awoke, and I am still with Thee.

verses.text: If Thou dost kill sinners, God— men of blood, turn away from me,
verses.display_text:
If Thou dost kill sinners, God—
men of blood, turn away from me,

verses.text: for Thou wilt speak into deliberation; they will take Thy cities into vanity.
verses.display_text:
for Thou wilt speak into deliberation;
they will take Thy cities into vanity.

verses.text: Did I not hate those who hate Thee, Lord, and melt away over Thine enemies?
verses.display_text:
Did I not hate those who hate Thee, Lord,
and melt away over Thine enemies?

verses.text: I hated them with complete hatred; they became enemies to me.
verses.display_text:
I hated them with complete hatred;
they became enemies to me.

verses.text: Test me, God, and know my heart; examine me and know my paths,
verses.display_text:
Test me, God, and know my heart;
examine me and know my paths,

verses.text: and see whether a way of lawlessness is in me, and guide me in an eternal way.
verses.display_text:
and see whether a way of lawlessness is in me,
and guide me in an eternal way.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm for David.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm for David.

verses.text: Rescue me, Lord, from an evil person; deliver me from an unjust man,
verses.display_text:
Rescue me, Lord, from an evil person;
deliver me from an unjust man,

verses.text: those who devised injustices in their heart and were arraying wars all day.
verses.display_text:
those who devised injustices in their heart
and were arraying wars all day.

verses.text: They sharpened their tongue like a serpent’s; asp venom is beneath their lips. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
They sharpened their tongue like a serpent’s;
asp venom is beneath their lips. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Guard me, Lord, from a sinner’s hand; rescue me from unjust people, those who devised to trip my steps.
The proud hid a trap for me and stretched cords, traps for my feet; along the path they set a stumbling block for me. Diapsalma.
I said to the Lord, “Thou art my God.” Listen, Lord, to the voice of my petition.
verses.display_text:
I said to the Lord, “Thou art my God.”
Listen, Lord, to the voice of my petition.

verses.text: Lord, Lord, power of my salvation, Thou didst overshadow my head on the day of war.
verses.display_text:
Lord, Lord, power of my salvation,
Thou didst overshadow my head on the day of war.

verses.text: Do not hand me over to a sinner, Lord, through my desire; they schemed against me; do not abandon me, lest they rise high. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Do not hand me over to a sinner, Lord, through my desire;
they schemed against me; do not abandon me, lest they rise high. Diapsalma.

verses.text: The head of their encirclement— the trouble of their lips will cover them.
verses.display_text:
The head of their encirclement—
the trouble of their lips will cover them.

verses.text: Coals will fall upon them; in fire Thou wilt cast them down; in miseries they will certainly not withstand.
A talkative man will not be set straight on the earth; evils will hunt an unjust man to destruction.
verses.display_text:
A talkative man will not be set straight on the earth;
evils will hunt an unjust man to destruction.

verses.text: I knew that the Lord will act for the poor person’s judgment and the needy people’s cause.
verses.display_text:
I knew that the Lord will act for the poor person’s judgment
and the needy people’s cause.

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will thank Thy name, and the upright will dwell with Thy presence.
verses.display_text:
Indeed, the righteous will thank Thy name,
and the upright will dwell with Thy presence.

verses.text: A psalm for David. Lord, I have cried unto Thee; hear me. Attend to the voice of my petition when I cry unto Thee.
verses.display_text:
A psalm for David.
Lord, I have cried unto Thee; hear me.
Attend to the voice of my petition when I cry unto Thee.

verses.text: Let my prayer be directed as incense before Thee, the lifting of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
verses.display_text:
Let my prayer be directed as incense before Thee,
the lifting of my hands as an evening sacrifice.

verses.text: Set a guard, Lord, for my mouth and a restraining door around my lips.
verses.display_text:
Set a guard, Lord, for my mouth
and a restraining door around my lips.

verses.text: Do not turn my heart toward words of wickedness, to offer excuses for sins with people who practice lawlessness, and I will certainly not join with their chosen ones.
verses.display_text:
Do not turn my heart toward words of wickedness,
to offer excuses for sins with people who practice lawlessness,
and I will certainly not join with their chosen ones.

verses.text: A righteous man will discipline me in mercy and correct me, but let a sinner’s oil not enrich my head, for still my prayer is amid their good pleasures.
verses.display_text:
A righteous man will discipline me in mercy and correct me,
but let a sinner’s oil not enrich my head,
for still my prayer is amid their good pleasures.

verses.text: Their judges were swallowed up beside a rock; they will hear my words, for they became sweet.
verses.display_text:
Their judges were swallowed up beside a rock;
they will hear my words, for they became sweet.

verses.text: Like a clod of earth broken upon the earth, our bones were scattered beside Hades.
verses.display_text:
Like a clod of earth broken upon the earth,
our bones were scattered beside Hades.

verses.text: For my eyes are toward Thee, Lord, Lord; in Thee I hoped—do not take away my soul.
verses.display_text:
For my eyes are toward Thee, Lord, Lord;
in Thee I hoped—do not take away my soul.

verses.text: Guard me from the trap they assembled for me and from the stumbling blocks of those practicing lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
Guard me from the trap they assembled for me
and from the stumbling blocks of those practicing lawlessness.

verses.text: Sinners will fall into his casting net; I am alone until I pass by.
verses.display_text:
Sinners will fall into his casting net;
I am alone until I pass by.

verses.text: Of understanding, of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
verses.display_text: Of understanding, of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.

verses.text: With my voice I cried to the Lord; with my voice I pleaded with the Lord.
verses.display_text:
With my voice I cried to the Lord;
with my voice I pleaded with the Lord.

verses.text: I will pour out my plea before Him; I will declare my affliction before Him.
verses.display_text:
I will pour out my plea before Him;
I will declare my affliction before Him.

verses.text: When my spirit was failing within me, Thou knewest my paths. On this way where I was walking, they hid a trap for me.
verses.display_text:
When my spirit was failing within me,
Thou knewest my paths.
On this way where I was walking, they hid a trap for me.

verses.text: I looked to the right and observed, for there was no one recognizing me. Escape perished from me, and there is no one seeking my soul.
verses.display_text:
I looked to the right and observed, for there was no one recognizing me.
Escape perished from me,
and there is no one seeking my soul.

verses.text: I cried unto Thee, Lord; I said, Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.
Attend to my plea, for I was brought very low. Rescue me from those pursuing me, for they grew stronger than I.
verses.display_text:
Attend to my plea, for I was brought very low.
Rescue me from those pursuing me,
for they grew stronger than I.

verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may thank Thy name, Lord. The righteous will wait for me until Thou repayest me.
verses.display_text:
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may thank Thy name, Lord.
The righteous will wait for me
until Thou repayest me.

verses.text: A psalm of David, when his son pursues him. Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my plea in Thy truth. Answer me in Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of David, when his son pursues him.
Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my plea in Thy truth.
Answer me in Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Do not enter into judgment with Thy servant, for no one living will be justified before Thee.
verses.display_text:
Do not enter into judgment with Thy servant,
for no one living will be justified before Thee.

verses.text: For the enemy pursued my soul, brought my life low to the ground, made me sit in dark places like those long dead.
verses.display_text:
For the enemy pursued my soul,
brought my life low to the ground,
made me sit in dark places like those long dead.

verses.text: My spirit grew despondent within me; within me my heart was troubled.
verses.display_text:
My spirit grew despondent within me;
within me my heart was troubled.

verses.text: I remembered ancient days and meditated on all Thy works; I was pondering the works of Thy hands.
I spread out my hands unto Thee; my soul is like a waterless land for Thee. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
I spread out my hands unto Thee;
my soul is like a waterless land for Thee. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit is spent. Do not turn Thy face away from me, or I shall become like those descending to the pit.
verses.display_text:
Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit is spent.
Do not turn Thy face away from me,
or I shall become like those descending to the pit.

verses.text: Make Thy mercy heard by me in the morning, for I hoped in Thee. Make known to me, Lord, the way I shall walk, for unto Thee I lifted my soul.
verses.display_text:
Make Thy mercy heard by me in the morning, for I hoped in Thee.
Make known to me, Lord, the way I shall walk,
for unto Thee I lifted my soul.

verses.text: Take me out from my enemies, Lord, for I fled unto Thee for refuge.
verses.display_text:
Take me out from my enemies, Lord,
for I fled unto Thee for refuge.

verses.text: Teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God. Thy good Spirit will lead me on level ground.
verses.display_text:
Teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God.
Thy good Spirit will lead me on level ground.

verses.text: For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt give me life; in Thy righteousness Thou wilt bring my soul out of distress.
verses.display_text:
For Thy name’s sake, Lord, Thou wilt give me life;
in Thy righteousness Thou wilt bring my soul out of distress.

verses.text: In Thy mercy Thou wilt utterly destroy my enemies and destroy all who distress my soul, for I am Thy servant.
verses.display_text:
In Thy mercy Thou wilt utterly destroy my enemies
and destroy all who distress my soul,
for I am Thy servant.

verses.text: Of David, concerning Goliath. Blessed is the Lord, my God, who trains my hands for battle array, my fingers for war.
verses.display_text:
Of David, concerning Goliath.
Blessed is the Lord, my God,
who trains my hands for battle array, my fingers for war.

verses.text: My mercy and my refuge, my Helper and my Rescuer, my Defender, in whom I hoped, who subjects my people beneath me.
verses.display_text:
My mercy and my refuge, my Helper and my Rescuer,
my Defender, in whom I hoped,
who subjects my people beneath me.

verses.text: Lord, what is man, that Thou becamest known to him, or a son of man, that Thou takest account of him?
verses.display_text:
Lord, what is man, that Thou becamest known to him,
or a son of man, that Thou takest account of him?

verses.text: A man was likened to futility; his days pass like a shadow.
verses.display_text:
A man was likened to futility;
his days pass like a shadow.

verses.text: Lord, bend Thy heavens and descend; touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.display_text:
Lord, bend Thy heavens and descend;
touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

verses.text: Flash lightning, and Thou wilt scatter them; send out Thine arrows, and Thou wilt throw them into confusion.
verses.display_text:
Flash lightning, and Thou wilt scatter them;
send out Thine arrows, and Thou wilt throw them into confusion.

verses.text: Send out Thy hand from on high; take me out and rescue me from many waters, from the hand of foreigners.
Whose mouth spoke futility, and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.
verses.display_text:
Whose mouth spoke futility,
and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.

verses.text: God, I will sing a new song unto Thee; on a ten-stringed psaltery I will make music unto Thee.
verses.display_text:
God, I will sing a new song unto Thee;
on a ten-stringed psaltery I will make music unto Thee.

verses.text: To Him who gives salvation to kings, who redeems David His servant from an evil sword.
verses.display_text:
To Him who gives salvation to kings,
who redeems David His servant from an evil sword.

verses.text: Rescue me and take me out from the hand of foreigners, whose mouth spoke futility and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.
verses.display_text:
Rescue me and take me out from the hand of foreigners,
whose mouth spoke futility
and whose right hand is a right hand of injustice.

verses.text: Whose sons are like young plants established in their youth, their daughters beautified, adorned all around like the likeness of a sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
Whose sons are like young plants established in their youth,
their daughters beautified,
adorned all around like the likeness of a sanctuary.

verses.text: Their storehouses full, pouring forth from this to that; their sheep bearing many young, multiplying in their outgoing places.
Their oxen fat; there is no collapse of a fence and no passage out, nor any cry in their squares.
They called happy the people who have these things; happy the people whose God is the Lord.
verses.display_text:
They called happy the people who have these things;
happy the people whose God is the Lord.

verses.text: A praise of David. I will exalt Thee, my God, my King, and bless Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
A praise of David.
I will exalt Thee, my God, my King,
and bless Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Every day I will bless Thee and praise Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
Every day I will bless Thee
and praise Thy name for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised; His greatness has no limit.
verses.display_text:
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised;
His greatness has no limit.

verses.text: Generation after generation will praise Thy works, and they will declare Thy power.
verses.display_text:
Generation after generation will praise Thy works,
and they will declare Thy power.

verses.text: They will speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness, and they will recount Thy wonders.
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness,
and they will recount Thy wonders.

verses.text: They will speak of the power of Thy fearsome acts, and they will recount Thy greatness.
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the power of Thy fearsome acts,
and they will recount Thy greatness.

verses.text: They will pour forth remembrance of the abundance of Thy kindness and rejoice in Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
They will pour forth remembrance of the abundance of Thy kindness
and rejoice in Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Compassionate and merciful is the Lord, patient and abundant in mercy.
verses.display_text:
Compassionate and merciful is the Lord,
patient and abundant in mercy.

verses.text: The Lord is kind to all, and His compassions are over all His works.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is kind to all,
and His compassions are over all His works.

verses.text: Let all Thy works give thanks unto Thee, Lord, and let Thy holy ones bless Thee.
verses.display_text:
Let all Thy works give thanks unto Thee, Lord,
and let Thy holy ones bless Thee.

verses.text: They will speak of the glory of Thy kingdom and tell of Thy might,
verses.display_text:
They will speak of the glory of Thy kingdom
and tell of Thy might,

verses.text: to make known to the sons of men Thy might and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.
verses.display_text:
to make known to the sons of men Thy might
and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.

verses.text: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and Thy lordship endures through every generation.
verses.display_text:
Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages,
and Thy lordship endures through every generation.

verses.text: Faithful is the Lord in His words, and holy in all His works.
verses.display_text:
Faithful is the Lord in His words,
and holy in all His works.

verses.text: The Lord supports all who are falling and raises up all who have been broken down.
verses.display_text:
The Lord supports all who are falling
and raises up all who have been broken down.

verses.text: The eyes of all hope in Thee, and Thou givest their food at the right time.
verses.display_text:
The eyes of all hope in Thee,
and Thou givest their food at the right time.

verses.text: Thou openest Thy hand and fillest every living creature with good pleasure.
verses.display_text:
Thou openest Thy hand
and fillest every living creature with good pleasure.

verses.text: The Lord is righteous in all His ways and holy in all His works.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is righteous in all His ways
and holy in all His works.

verses.text: The Lord is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.
verses.display_text:
The Lord is near to all who call on Him,
to all who call on Him in truth.

verses.text: He will fulfill the will of those who fear Him; He will hear their plea and save them.
verses.display_text:
He will fulfill the will of those who fear Him;
He will hear their plea and save them.

verses.text: The Lord guards all who love Him, and all sinners He will utterly destroy.
verses.display_text:
The Lord guards all who love Him,
and all sinners He will utterly destroy.

verses.text: My mouth will speak the Lord’s praise, and let all flesh bless His holy name for the age and for the age of the age.
verses.display_text:
My mouth will speak the Lord’s praise,
and let all flesh bless His holy name
for the age and for the age of the age.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, my soul.
verses.display_text:
Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah.
Praise the Lord, my soul.

verses.text: I will praise the Lord throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
verses.display_text:
I will praise the Lord throughout my life;
I will make music to my God as long as I exist.

verses.text: Do not trust in rulers and in sons of men who have no salvation.
verses.display_text:
Do not trust in rulers
and in sons of men who have no salvation.

verses.text: His spirit will go out, and he will return to his earth; on that day all their reasonings will perish.
verses.display_text:
His spirit will go out, and he will return to his earth;
on that day all their reasonings will perish.

verses.text: Happy the one whose Helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God,
verses.display_text:
Happy the one whose Helper is the God of Jacob,
whose hope is in the Lord his God,

verses.text: who made heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them, who keeps truth for ever,
verses.display_text:
who made heaven and earth,
the sea and all that is in them,
who keeps truth for ever,

verses.text: who does justice for those wronged, who gives food to the hungry. The Lord releases those in fetters.
verses.display_text:
who does justice for those wronged,
who gives food to the hungry.
The Lord releases those in fetters.

verses.text: The Lord raises up those broken down; the Lord makes the blind wise; the Lord loves the righteous.
The Lord guards the newcomers; He will take up the orphan and widow, and He will obliterate the way of sinners.
The Lord will reign for ever, your God, Zion, through every generation.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will reign for ever,
your God, Zion, through every generation.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord, for a psalm is good; may praise be pleasing to our God.
The Lord builds Jerusalem, and He will gather the dispersed of Israel.
verses.display_text:
The Lord builds Jerusalem,
and He will gather the dispersed of Israel.

verses.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their fractures.
verses.display_text:
He heals the brokenhearted
and binds up their fractures.

verses.text: He numbers multitudes of stars and calls them all by names.
verses.display_text:
He numbers multitudes of stars
and calls them all by names.

verses.text: Great is our Lord, and great is His strength; His understanding is beyond number.
verses.display_text:
Great is our Lord, and great is His strength;
His understanding is beyond number.

verses.text: The Lord takes up the meek, but brings sinners low to the ground.
verses.display_text:
The Lord takes up the meek,
but brings sinners low to the ground.

verses.text: Begin singing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make music to our God with a lyre,
verses.display_text:
Begin singing to the Lord with thanksgiving;
make music to our God with a lyre,

verses.text: who clothes heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass sprout on the mountains and green growth for the service of humans,
verses.display_text:
who clothes heaven with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass sprout on the mountains
and green growth for the service of humans,

verses.text: who gives the cattle their food and to the young ravens who call upon Him.
verses.display_text:
who gives the cattle their food
and to the young ravens who call upon Him.

verses.text: He will not delight in the horse’s might, nor does He take pleasure in a man’s shins.
verses.display_text:
He will not delight in the horse’s might,
nor does He take pleasure in a man’s shins.

verses.text: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him and in those who hope in His mercy.
verses.display_text:
The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him
and in those who hope in His mercy.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Commend the Lord, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
For He strengthened the bars of your gates; He blessed your children within you.
verses.display_text:
For He strengthened the bars of your gates;
He blessed your children within you.

verses.text: He makes your borders peaceful and fills you with the finest wheat.
verses.display_text:
He makes your borders peaceful
and fills you with the finest wheat.

verses.text: He sends His oracle to the earth; His word will run swiftly,
verses.display_text:
He sends His oracle to the earth;
His word will run swiftly,

verses.text: of Him who gives snow like wool, who sprinkles mist like ashes,
verses.display_text:
of Him who gives snow like wool,
who sprinkles mist like ashes,

verses.text: who casts His ice like morsels; who will withstand His cold?
verses.display_text:
who casts His ice like morsels;
who will withstand His cold?

verses.text: He will send His word and melt them; He will blow His wind, and waters will flow.
verses.display_text:
He will send His word and melt them;
He will blow His wind, and waters will flow.

verses.text: He declares His word to Jacob, His ordinances and judgments to Israel.
verses.display_text:
He declares His word to Jacob,
His ordinances and judgments to Israel.

verses.text: He did not do so for any nation, and He did not disclose His judgments to them.
verses.display_text:
He did not do so for any nation,
and He did not disclose His judgments to them.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Of Haggai and Zechariah. Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His powers.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, all His angels;
praise Him, all His powers.

verses.text: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all the stars and the light.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, sun and moon;
praise Him, all the stars and the light.

verses.text: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and the water above the heavens.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him, heavens of heavens,
and the water above the heavens.

verses.text: Let them praise the Lord’s name, for He spoke, and they came to be; He commanded, and they were created.

verses.display_text:
He established them for the age and for the age of the age;
He set a command, and it will not pass away.

verses.text: Praise the Lord from the earth, dragons and all deeps,
verses.display_text:
Praise the Lord from the earth,
dragons and all deeps,

verses.text: fire, hail, snow, ice, storm wind—all fulfilling His word,
verses.display_text:
fire, hail, snow, ice,
storm wind—all fulfilling His word,

verses.text: mountains and all hills, fruit-bearing trees and all cedars,
verses.display_text:
mountains and all hills,
fruit-bearing trees and all cedars,

verses.text: wild animals and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds,
verses.display_text:
wild animals and all cattle,
creeping things and winged birds,

verses.text: kings of the earth and all peoples, rulers and all judges of the earth,
verses.display_text:
kings of the earth and all peoples,
rulers and all judges of the earth,

verses.text: young men and young women, old people with younger people.
verses.display_text:
young men and young women,
old people with younger people.

verses.text: Let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone was exalted; His praise is over earth and heaven.
verses.display_text:
Let them praise the Lord’s name, for His name alone was exalted;
His praise is over earth and heaven.

verses.text: He will raise a horn of His people— a hymn for all His holy ones, for the children of Israel, a people drawing near to Him.
verses.display_text:
He will raise a horn of His people—
a hymn for all His holy ones,
for the children of Israel, a people drawing near to Him.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Sing a new song to the Lord, His praise in the assembly of holy ones.
verses.display_text:
Hallelujah.
Sing a new song to the Lord,
His praise in the assembly of holy ones.

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in the One who made it, and let Zion’s children exult in their King.
verses.display_text:
Let Israel rejoice in the One who made it,
and let Zion’s children exult in their King.

verses.text: Let them praise His name in a chorus; with tambourine and psaltery let them make music to Him.
verses.display_text:
Let them praise His name in a chorus;
with tambourine and psaltery let them make music to Him.

verses.text: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people, and He will exalt the meek in salvation.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord takes pleasure in His people,
and He will exalt the meek in salvation.

verses.text: Holy ones will boast in glory and rejoice upon their beds.
verses.display_text:
Holy ones will boast in glory
and rejoice upon their beds.

verses.text: Exaltations of God in their throat, and two-edged swords in their hands,
verses.display_text:
Exaltations of God in their throat,
and two-edged swords in their hands,

verses.text: to execute vengeance among the nations, reproofs among the peoples,
verses.display_text:
to execute vengeance among the nations,
reproofs among the peoples,

verses.text: to bind their kings in fetters and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,
verses.display_text:
to bind their kings in fetters
and their glorious ones in iron handcuffs,

verses.text: to execute upon them a written judgment. This is glory for all His holy ones.
verses.display_text:
to execute upon them a written judgment.
This is glory for all His holy ones.

verses.text: Hallelujah. Praise God among His holy ones; praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him for His mighty acts;
praise Him according to the abundance of His greatness.

verses.text: Praise Him with the sound of a trumpet; praise Him with psaltery and lyre.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with the sound of a trumpet;
praise Him with psaltery and lyre.

verses.text: Praise Him with tambourine and chorus; praise Him with strings and instrument.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with tambourine and chorus;
praise Him with strings and instrument.

verses.text: Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals; praise Him with cymbals of a shout.
verses.display_text:
Praise Him with well-sounding cymbals;
praise Him with cymbals of a shout.

verses.text: Let every breath praise the Lord. Hallelujah.
verses.display_text:
Let every breath praise the Lord.
Hallelujah.

verses.text: This psalm is personally written concerning David and is outside the number, when he fought Goliath in single combat. I was small among my brothers and younger in my father’s house; I was shepherding my father’s sheep.
verses.display_text:
This psalm is personally written concerning David and is outside the number, when he fought Goliath in single combat.
I was small among my brothers
and younger in my father’s house;
I was shepherding my father’s sheep.

verses.text: My hands made an instrument; my fingers fitted a psaltery.
verses.display_text:
My hands made an instrument;
my fingers fitted a psaltery.

verses.text: And who shall tell my Lord? He Himself is Lord; He Himself hears.
verses.display_text:
And who shall tell my Lord?
He Himself is Lord; He Himself hears.

verses.text: He Himself sent out His angel and took me from my father’s sheep and anointed me with the oil of His anointing.
verses.display_text:
He Himself sent out His angel
and took me from my father’s sheep
and anointed me with the oil of His anointing.

verses.text: My brothers were handsome and tall, but the Lord took no pleasure in them.
verses.display_text:
My brothers were handsome and tall,
but the Lord took no pleasure in them.

verses.text: I went out to meet the foreigner, and he cursed me by his idols.
verses.display_text:
I went out to meet the foreigner,
and he cursed me by his idols.

verses.text: But I drew the sword he carried, cut off his head, and removed reproach from the sons of Israel.
verses.display_text:
But I drew the sword he carried,
cut off his head,
and removed reproach from the sons of Israel.
